name: know-fu
description: A local research library your agent compiles from books, papers and videos, then explains, applies and invents from.

interface.shortDescription: A research library compiled from your sources.
interface.longDescription: A local library of plain Markdown: a principles page per topic, consolidated accounts with page citations, and the original sources kept searchable underneath. Codex does the reading and reasoning; a small engine extracts, checks and searches.
defaultPrompt: Ingest this source into my library.
What does my library say about this?
Help me design this from the library's principles.
